title: HistoryRevisionsPruneResponse
description: HistoryPruneResult or wire error. Use the success branch OR error — not both. deleted counts checkpoints deleted by this call (excludes the live row and derived revisions); floor_revision = newest_deleted_checkpoint_revision + 1 when at least one checkpoint is deleted, null otherwise (no-op, including keep >= checkpoint count). Codes documented for history.revisions.prune: INVALID_INPUT (absent idempotency_key), IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, RECEIPT_EXPIRED, NOT_FOUND, HISTORY_ENTITY_UNSUPPORTED, plus the entity's existing write-authorization outcome. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.

deleted.description: Number of checkpoints deleted by this call.

floor_revision.description: Newest deleted checkpoint revision + 1 when at least one checkpoint was deleted; null on a no-op. The current retained floor for subsequent replay.
